learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the vibrant world of theatre genres and learn how different types of scripts create completely different magical experiences for the audience!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like ice cream has different flavors, plays have different styles called genres. A comedy makes you burst into laughter, while a tragedy touches your heart with serious and emotional stories.
Street plays or Nukkad Nataks do not need fancy auditoriums. Actors perform in open spaces to spread important social messages, using loud voices, catchy songs, and bold energetic movements.
A play is never a one-way street! The energy of the audience directly affects the actors on stage. When the audience laughs or gasps, the actors feel that energy and perform even better.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Genre Switcheroo
fun_activity.instructions: Take a simple daily situation like buying vegetables. Act it out twice with your friends or family: first as a super serious dramatic tragedy, and then as a hilarious slapstick comedy!

quick_recap: ⭐ Theatre comes in many exciting styles like comedy, tragedy, and folk drama.
⭐ Street plays use high energy and open spaces to share powerful social messages with everyday people.
⭐ The audience is the secret ingredient of a live performance because their reactions fuel the actors' energy.
